name: Web Fetch
description: Fetch a public HTTP(S) URL and return readable Markdown (HTML pages) or plain text.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: HTTP GET a URL. HTML responses are converted to Markdown. Private/loopback hosts are blocked. Long content pages instead of truncating — when the response ends with 'Continue with offset=N', call again with that offset to get the rest.

url.description: http or https URL to fetch.

offset.description: 0-based character offset to start the page from (default 0). Use the offset from a prior response's 'Continue with offset=N' to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Max characters to return in this page (default 100000, max 400000).
